title: ye
description: The cover art features the mountains of Jackson Hole, Wyoming on the night of Ye's album listening party. The green lettering captures the last-minute character of the cover art, looking as if it has been scribbled on the photo at short notice. The caption appears to be a paradox, but it is basically a bipolar statement about being bipolar, emphasizing Ye's mental state: He hates being bipolar when in his depression phases, but then he loves it when in his euphoria phases.

Around February of 2009 they started working on Good Ass Job and brought some work over from 2008, with development really kicking in around April 2009.
